# open-dom-heatmap

> Zero-dependency JavaScript library for colouring order-book (liquidity / market-depth) heatmaps: each price level is
> compared with its local and wide background, stretched between recalibrated percentile cut-offs, smoothed and persisted
> over time; bounded per-bucket memory allows exact parallel backfill in web workers; a renderer keeps high-volume levels
> visible when zoomed out (volume dominance) and scrolls incrementally.

## Docs

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): README, agent instructions and the full typed API in one file
- [README](README.md): features, quick start, API, input format, settings, benchmarks, how it works
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): install and usage steps for coding agents
- [src/index.d.ts](src/index.d.ts): TypeScript declarations of every export

## Source

- [src/chart.js](src/chart.js): DomHeatmap — ready-made canvas chart (zoom, pan, follow, incremental scroll)
- [src/book.js](src/book.js): bookToColumn, Columnizer — from an order book to heatmap columns
- [demo/live.js](demo/live.js): complete live example with the Binance depth stream
- [src/processor.js](src/processor.js): StableProcessor (process one column → Uint8Array 0…255 per bucket)
- [src/backfill.js](src/backfill.js): processHistory (parallel chunks with warm-up), processSequential
- [src/render.js](src/render.js): HeatRenderer (volume dominance, incremental scroll), buildPalette
- [demo/synth.js](demo/synth.js): synthetic order-book history generator
